system.description: Choose one Talent that you already possess. The Talent you select must be from either the Expert Pilot Talent Tree or the Gunner Talent Tree. Once per encounter as a Standard Action, you can impart the benefits of the chosen Talent to all members of your squadron. Once gained, its benefits last until the end of the encounter.
